notes: The section heading identifies Inishie as a limited express.
The release does not print internal train numbers.
JR West publishes the release, but no ordered operator-boundary table is printed.
The selected date is Sunday within the printed summer period and the table says 土休日.
Each directional row prints its endpoint departure and arrival.
The directional rows list Kyoto, Uji and Nara in order.
Every printed clock is retained verbatim; Uji departures are not printed or inferred.
No physical line identities are printed in the selected table.
Each source name resolves to one JR West sourceCode in the current package.
Official URL and SHA-256 are pinned; no reuse grant was identified.
